metadata.priority_note: P0 is launch-required, P1 is optional; phase is a separate integer.
metadata.release_gate_note: Dependencies are scheduling prerequisites, not the complete release checklist. IN05 must review every launch-required task and IA entry. Any scope cut must be explicitly recorded; removing a dependency does not waive acceptance.

tasks.title: Source and rewrite inventory
tasks.implementation: Record source commits, copied logic, old entrypoints to retire, actual proto paths, and data-environment separation.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Every reuse entry names source/destination/test; no production-data deletion in cutover plan.

tasks.title: Reproducible workspace and toolchain
tasks.implementation: Freeze retained package resolutions, add Phaser 3.90.0, pin Node patch/image, map backend lockfile, and create scoped checks.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Clean frozen-lockfile install and minimal frontend/backend build; record versions and commands.

tasks.title: Core HTTP and identity contract
tasks.implementation: Map actual auth operation IDs and tokens; define Bootstrap, public/private profile, avatar, places, errors, and capabilities.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Schema-valid success/failure examples; exact frontend/backend auth mapping reviewed.

tasks.title: Domain HTTP and transition contracts
tasks.implementation: Define party, reservation, social, age, feed, mural, admin commands; actor permissions, idempotency, and versions.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Every command has actor, precondition, resulting state, error reason, and retry rule.

tasks.title: Realtime wire protocol
tasks.implementation: Define authenticate, snapshot, input, delta, resync, revoke, room switch, and stream sequence rules.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Reject unknown/oversized messages; filtered streams have no false sequence gaps.

tasks.title: Map and avatar interfaces
tasks.implementation: Define atlas frames/anchor, layer IDs, map version, collisions, interactions, and place-source metadata.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Small golden asset fixtures validate and align across all themes.

tasks.title: Generated clients and fixture harness
tasks.implementation: Generate TS API types, validate Zod compatibility, deterministic clock/seed, mock scenarios, and drift checks.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Generated output is reproducible; a deliberate schema mismatch fails CI.

tasks.title: New-UI and source-boundary gate
tasks.implementation: Inventory legacy rendering files and hashes; allow only reviewed headless extracts; prohibit legacy styles and visual imports.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Gate detects an imported or copied legacy control; manual visual review remains required.

tasks.title: Venue source and landmark pack
tasks.implementation: Verify relative buildings/paths from authorized references; distinguish temporary unverified gates and public meeting places.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Every physical place has source, review state, photo permission, and closure handling.

tasks.title: Walkable venue tilemap
tasks.implementation: Build terrain, collision, overdraw, interaction, spawn, and landmark layers from the reviewed source pack.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: All spawn points are walkable; interaction IDs resolve; blocked routes cannot be traversed.

tasks.title: Original avatar atlases
tasks.implementation: Deliver six presets and agreed layered assets using the fixed anchor and direction/frame layout.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: No clipping, missing frames, or theme-dependent identity changes at actual mobile scale.

tasks.title: Three world skin packs
tasks.implementation: Produce Revenge/Parade/Danger decorations and palettes without changing geometry or collision IDs.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Pixel readability and contrast pass for all skins; manifest hashes and licenses recorded.

tasks.title: Import port-rust foundations
tasks.implementation: Import the selected workspace with provenance; retire old competing executable entrypoints; preserve required service boundaries.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Workspace resolves and builds; one documented process/port map; no accidental old DB target.

tasks.title: Relocate build and migration tooling
tasks.implementation: Repair relative paths, protobuf generation, SQLx migrations, health checks, image contexts, and isolated DB credentials.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Fresh isolated database migrates; services restart and persist a smoke record.

tasks.title: Browser auth contract adapter
tasks.implementation: Wire signup/verify/login/reset/refresh/logout/provider discovery to the mapped contract; enforce safe redirects and cookie protections.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Real isolated signup/login/refresh/logout; expired/reused credentials and invalid OAuth state rejected.

tasks.title: Canonical participant identity adapter
tasks.implementation: Resolve Auth UUID, basic Profile projection, suspension state, and explicit provider-to-user binding; remove X-account prerequisite.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Email-only user participates; foreign identity cannot attach claims; private profile fields never leak.

tasks.title: Concert service and core schema
tasks.implementation: Add hexagonal modules, typed errors, migrations for events/participants/avatar settings, clock and policy ports.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Migration uniqueness checks and dependency-boundary tests; service health and isolated startup.

tasks.title: Bootstrap and participant defaults
tasks.implementation: Implement idempotent participant creation, preset avatar, event capabilities, manifests, and server clock aggregation.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Repeated bootstrap creates one participant; degraded optional dependencies do not fabricate data.

tasks.title: Avatar and preference persistence
tasks.implementation: Validate asset IDs/layers/version; update avatar and theme with optimistic concurrency and bounded payloads.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Invalid URL/item rejected; stale version conflicts; other users' outfits remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Places and map-release reads
tasks.implementation: Store reviewed landmarks and immutable map manifests; expose closure and verification; separate concept-only objects.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Unknown/closed place cannot be selected for a new physical beacon; manifest mismatch has a typed error.

tasks.title: Physical beacon lifecycle
tasks.implementation: Create/read/update/revoke scoped beacons; DB-time TTL; revision changes; audience authorization through policy ports.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Expired, revoked, blocked, and unrelated viewers receive no private meeting details.

tasks.title: One-use world admission tickets
tasks.implementation: Issue user/session/event/room-bound 30-second tickets; atomic consumption; no credential in URLs/logs.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Reuse, wrong room, expired ticket, wrong origin, and unauthenticated frames rejected.

tasks.title: Room registry and membership leases
tasks.implementation: One owner process per room; bounded capacity, session membership, join/switch/leave, and disconnect grace lease.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Concurrent joins never exceed cap; switching cannot duplicate membership; ghost leases expire.

tasks.title: Authoritative movement loop
tasks.implementation: Fixed-step movement from normalized input; speed limits, collision grid, valid spawn, and interaction range.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Teleport, excessive speed, invalid axis, sequence replay, and wall penetration tests.

tasks.title: Recipient-specific snapshots and deltas
tasks.implementation: Project authorized players, stable snapshot baseline, per-stream sequence, avatar versions, bounded/coalesced queues.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Two viewers with different block filters resynchronize correctly; slow receiver cannot grow memory unboundedly.

tasks.title: Reconnect and authorization revocation
tasks.implementation: Handle epoch changes, expired session, suspension, close codes, resync, and app foregrounding without motion replay.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: New snapshot after server restart; removed/expired session cannot recover its old subscriptions.

tasks.title: Domain outbox and command receipts
tasks.implementation: Transactional event enqueue; idempotency-body hashes; bounded retries and delivery deduplication.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Crash after commit does not lose event; duplicate event consumed once; changed payload/key conflicts.

tasks.title: Party aggregate and CRUD
tasks.implementation: Event/ticket section, owner, capacity, rendezvous, lifecycle and version constraints; public projection excludes applicants.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Non-owner edits fail; invalid capacity/window rejected; cancelled party is not joinable.

tasks.title: Applications and atomic approval
tasks.implementation: Unique application, owner decision, transaction-guarded member count, idempotent response and outbox notification.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Two approvals for last slot produce one membership; duplicate apply does not create extra rows.

tasks.title: Leave, remove, and cancel party
tasks.implementation: Enforce actor permissions, leader cancellation/transfer rule, capacity release and immediate audience revocation.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Removed member loses rally/beacon access; owner cannot orphan an active party.

tasks.title: Rally and real-arrival commands
tasks.implementation: Member-only state and meeting revision; explicit ON_MY_WAY/HERE/MET/NEED_HELP; no virtual-position inference.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Nonmember rejected; venue change invalidates stale rally instructions; self-state actor checked.

tasks.title: Giveaway aggregate and catalog
tasks.implementation: Owner CRUD, public filters, quantity and pickup-window validation, pause/cancel and optimistic stock edits.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Quantity cannot drop below committed units; recipients absent from public lists and details.

tasks.title: Atomic reservation command
tasks.implementation: Guarded stock decrement/hold, unique active user reservation, request receipt, and pickup-window expiry.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: One unit with five simultaneous buyers yields exactly one hold; retry returns original receipt.

tasks.title: Cancellation and expiry worker
tasks.implementation: Conditional terminal transition and stock release in one transaction; DB clock, bounded batches, restart-safe scans.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Cancellation/expiry/claim races do not double-release stock; restart resumes pending expiry.

tasks.title: Pickup confirmation and receipts
tasks.implementation: Bind confirmation to reservation/authorized actors; hashed expiring code, guess limits, terminal claim receipt.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Duplicate claim consumes no extra stock; wrong owner/code/expired hold is rejected.

tasks.title: Authorized image upload pipeline
tasks.implementation: Initialize/finalize upload; byte/MIME/dimension limits, decode/reencode, metadata removal, ownership and private read control.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Forged MIME, oversized image, foreign upload ID, and unauthorized private media read fail.

tasks.title: Extract introduction and age policy
tasks.implementation: Port pure rule semantics and fixtures; replace source identity types and database-bound helpers with explicit ports.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Half-open range, null bounds, unknown claims, supported limits, and no public policy leakage.

tasks.title: Verified-age claim persistence
tasks.implementation: Port claim expiry, next-birthday and canonical replacement; verified callback-to-user binding; provider availability capability.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Seoul birthday boundary, expired/replaced claims, callback replay, and missing provider fail closed.

tasks.title: Introduction authoring and discovery
tasks.implementation: Owner draft/publish/close, eligibility-aware discovery/detail, approved public profile projection, pagination.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Direct ID and list paths enforce the same eligibility; unknown verification cannot bypass a restriction.

tasks.title: Private social-handle storage
tasks.implementation: Normalize platform handle, encrypt at rest with managed secret, version changes, removal, and no plaintext logging.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Public DTO serialization rejects handles; replacement invalidates old-version grant bindings.

tasks.title: Mutual social-sharing decisions
tasks.implementation: Requester's explicit consent, recipient approval/rejection, per-platform reciprocal grants, expiry and revocation.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: No grant before both relevant consents; duplicate decision is idempotent; blocked pair rejected.

tasks.title: Authorized reveal endpoint
tasks.implementation: Recheck grant versions, platform, expiry, block, suspension and actor; no-store response and privacy invalidation event.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Approved, unrelated, expired, revoked, changed-handle and blocked scenarios; no leaked error metadata.

tasks.title: Event feed and post adapter
tasks.implementation: Add event scoping, latest cursor feed, public party/giveaway references and ordinary post CRUD through the owner service.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Cross-event/private references excluded; stable cursor order; linked entity is reauthorized.

tasks.title: Comments, reactions, and content controls
tasks.implementation: Map comments/reactions, owner edit/delete, visibility filtering and moderation receipts to inherited contracts.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Blocked reply paths fail; deleted/hidden post cannot be recovered through a comment route.

tasks.title: Concert notification adapter
tasks.implementation: Deduplicate domain event delivery, safe summary text, own inbox/read state and authorized target links.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: No handle/location secret in payload; repeated delivery creates one notification; stale target handled.

tasks.title: Mural writes and cooldown
tasks.implementation: Grid/palette bounds, server-time per-user cooldown, atomic operation/revision/outbox update, write freeze check.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Parallel requests cannot bypass cooldown; invalid coordinates/colors rejected; DB failure produces no false commit.

tasks.title: Mural snapshot and realtime changes
tasks.implementation: Produce consistent snapshot revision and ordered deltas; resume or full-resync on missed retention window.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: New subscriber and reconnecting subscriber converge to the same pixels and revision.

tasks.title: Reports and evidence access
tasks.implementation: Typed targets, reason limits, duplicate/spam handling, reporter privacy and role-scoped evidence retrieval.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Target never sees reporter identity; ordinary member cannot inspect moderator evidence.

tasks.title: Shared relationship policy port
tasks.implementation: Adapt inherited blocks/suspensions to canonical users; common authorization and invalidation hook for HTTP/WS/projections.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Bidirectional block and unblocking semantics; unavailable policy cannot reveal private data.

tasks.title: Event settings, notices, and flags
tasks.implementation: Operator roles, reviewed publication, source timestamps, place closure, feature availability and read-only gates.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Client-hidden feature still rejected server-side; nonoperator writes forbidden.

tasks.title: Moderation commands and audit trail
tasks.implementation: Suspend/hide/restore with reason and immutable receipt; invoke owner services and terminate affected sessions.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Action/result tied to actor; failed downstream action is not recorded as successfully applied.

tasks.title: Mural pause, lock, and restore
tasks.implementation: Region locks, global pause/freeze, restore from authorized snapshot into a new revision; force client resync.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Writes during freeze rejected; restore never reuses old sequence numbers; audit receipt exists.

tasks.title: Event closure and archive jobs
tasks.implementation: Idempotent read-only transition, permitted archive projection, grant/beacon expiry and resumable retention jobs.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Partial failure resumes; public archive excludes private locations, recipients, and handles.

tasks.title: Account-deletion integration
tasks.implementation: Extend deletion orchestration to Concert; revoke sessions/tickets/grants, scrub retained personal fields, retry durable steps.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Repeated deletion safe; removed user cannot reconnect or reveal; failed step remains visible for retry.

tasks.title: Boundary and abuse hardening
tasks.implementation: Scope-specific rate limits, content bounds, header/origin rules, redacted logs, no-store private responses, dependency audit.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Negative tests for auth/CSRF/origin/replay/upload/oversized WS; no secrets in captured logs.

tasks.title: Reproducible real-stack startup
tasks.implementation: Wire all inherited services and Concert, persistent volumes, real/mock provider separation, health and shutdown ordering.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Fresh startup and restart smoke; disabled provider is honestly unavailable, not simulated success.

tasks.title: Extract and adapt HTTP transport
tasks.implementation: Port cancellation, error normalization and safe upload helpers; replace endpoint/auth assumptions with typed client ports.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Mock 401/409/429/network abort; no old `/v1` calls or token persistence.

tasks.title: Identity-neutral queries and invalidation
tasks.implementation: Replace activeXAccountId with user/event scope; cancellation and private-cache eviction on auth/policy changes.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Account A's delayed response cannot populate account B; no retained reveal after revoke.

tasks.title: Extract pure form and policy helpers
tasks.implementation: Port required Zod/pure logic only; separate mixed TSX logic from rendering; adapt canonical IDs and error enums.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Existing semantic fixtures pass; no import from old pages/components/styles.

tasks.title: Headless image upload controller
tasks.implementation: Extract image compression, preview cleanup, progress, abort, finalize and retry state; exclude video/FFmpeg.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Abort frees resources; failed finalize is not shown as uploaded; no credential on presigned PUT.

tasks.title: New accessible UI primitives
tasks.implementation: Author buttons, fields, dialogs, sheet, tabs, status, toast, skeleton and error panels from new markup/styles.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Keyboard/focus/dialog dismissal tests; 44px targets; no legacy visual imports.

tasks.title: Three-theme token system
tasks.implementation: New Revenge/Parade/Danger tokens, selection persistence, asset-loading fallback, reduced-motion transitions.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Theme switch preserves geometry, room and avatar identity; failed asset load restores previous skin.

tasks.title: Persistent world shell and routes
tasks.implementation: Build header, six tabs, nested panels, history/back semantics, safe return paths, lazy public/admin route boundaries.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Panel navigation creates no duplicate world/socket; direct gift link initializes shell correctly.

tasks.title: New public landing and legal views
tasks.implementation: New world-first landing, entry CTA, versioned legal/safety/contact pages; signed-in redirect.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Anonymous pages load without Phaser; signed-in home resolves to world; no old homepage markup.

tasks.title: Session controller and sign-in
tasks.implementation: In-memory token, single-flight refresh, safe bootstrap, login/logout, provider availability, complete private-state cleanup.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Concurrent 401s perform one refresh; failed login and unavailable provider have truthful states.

tasks.title: Signup and verification views
tasks.implementation: New forms using mapped server flow, validation, consent, challenge expiry and server resend countdown.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Expired verification cannot complete; double submit does not create extra requests.

tasks.title: Reset-password and callback views
tasks.implementation: New request/confirm reset views and OAuth callback error/return-target handling; sanitize local redirects.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Unknown email uses neutral response; hostile return URL rejected; denial returns safely.

tasks.title: Shared avatar compositor
tasks.implementation: Deterministic layer composition, frame/anchor mapping, texture cache, and shared profile-thumbnail export.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Golden-config render aligns across world/profile; missing asset uses documented fallback.

tasks.title: New avatar editor
tasks.implementation: New large preview, presets and item selectors; draft/save/cancel; optimistic-version conflict without losing draft.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Save changes world and profile consistently; cancelling retains persisted outfit.

tasks.title: Phaser runtime and map loader
tasks.implementation: Single lifecycle-managed game, manifest version/hash, layers, nearest-neighbor textures and resize/cleanup.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Repeated React mount cleanup leaks no canvas/listeners; invalid map fails visibly.

tasks.title: Mobile movement, camera, and interactions
tasks.implementation: Pointer-safe joystick/tap movement, keyboard control, collision prediction, recenter, selection and blocking-panel pause.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Pointercancel/blur stops movement; keyboard opening and panel input never move the avatar accidentally.

tasks.title: Realtime transport implementations
tasks.implementation: Same interface for mock and real transport; ticket/authenticate, typed messages, sequence and close handling.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Identical scenario suite runs with both transports; mock code excluded from production mode.

tasks.title: Replication and reconnect controller
tasks.implementation: Snapshot baseline, interpolation, bounded prediction/reconciliation, epoch reset and visibility-driven reconnect.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Missing delta requests resync; restart removes ghosts; no replay of old pickup/reservation commands.

tasks.title: Rooms and accessible nearby list
tasks.implementation: New channel chooser, switch feedback, room cap states and DOM list of authorized nearby avatars.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Full room handled without losing current membership; blocked character disappears from both representations.

tasks.title: Map, place details, and help
tasks.implementation: New overview and place sheet, source/closed states, physical/virtual legend, accessible actions and controls help.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Concept-only place never offered as verified physical destination; map mismatch produces recovery UI.

tasks.title: Physical check-in and meeting beacon
tasks.implementation: New audience/TTL form, last-confirmed time, photo/identification, moved/stale/revoked views and explicit arrival actions.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Virtual avatar motion does not change physical check-in; expired beacon cannot masquerade as current.

tasks.title: Party discovery and application
tasks.implementation: New filters/list/detail, apply/cancel mutation state and capability-driven actions, MY PLAN link.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Empty/full/private/cancelled states; uncertain request reconciles by receipt instead of duplicate application.

tasks.title: Party authoring form
tasks.implementation: New create/edit form for capacity, ticket section, time, place, and intro; RHF validation and safe draft restore.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Invalid time/capacity rejected locally and server errors mapped; version conflict keeps draft.

tasks.title: Party management and rally
tasks.implementation: New application decisions/member list and explicit ON_MY_WAY/HERE/MET/NEED_HELP controls; remove/cancel confirmations.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Last-slot conflict updates UI; removed member loses panel access; moved meeting visibly supersedes old card.

tasks.title: Giveaway discovery and own activity
tasks.implementation: New list/detail and GIVING/RECEIVING views, remaining-stock/time filters and current action eligibility.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: No recipient identities in public view; paused/sold-out/ended states prevent invalid actions.

tasks.title: Giveaway authoring and owner tools
tasks.implementation: New item/photo/quantity/window/place form and owner reservation inventory table; pause/cancel/edit flows.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Stock-edit conflict preserves form; unauthorized owner-tools route is unavailable.

tasks.title: Reservation and pickup journey
tasks.implementation: Idempotency-key lifecycle, hold receipt, expiry, meeting detail, confirmation code, owner claim and cancellation.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Timeout/reload reconciles with server; expired/sold-out/repeated pickup never shows fake success.

tasks.title: Event timeline and notices
tasks.implementation: New compact chronological feed, filters, cursor loading, linked party/gift references and source-stamped notices.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Stable ordering; revoked linked target safely disappears; no private activity projection.

tasks.title: Thread, composer, and comments
tasks.implementation: New post/comment/reaction views, edit/delete, image upload, draft handling and report entry.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Deleted/hidden/conflicting content handled; double submission and failed upload recover cleanly.

tasks.title: People and introduction discovery
tasks.implementation: New people list and filters, avatar-focused items, opaque eligibility/unavailable states and profile entry.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: User without X account can browse allowed content; exact age and secret handles absent.

tasks.title: Introduction editor, profile, age status
tasks.implementation: New intro/profile rendering, private condition form and verified/unknown/expired/provider-unavailable flow.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Half-open boundary fixtures; policy detail visible only to owner; no self-declared verified badge.

tasks.title: Private social-sharing UI
tasks.implementation: New handle settings, explicit request consent, decisions, reveal, revoke and expiry views; no-store sensitive fetch.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Network payload before approval contains no handle; revocation clears UI/cache; no auto-follow claim.

tasks.title: Mural editing surface
tasks.implementation: New grid/palette, pan/zoom and pixel preview; confirm action; touch disambiguation and DOM controls.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Dragging does not place pixels; bounds/color/cooldown states correct on 360px screen.

tasks.title: Mural synchronization and world object
tasks.implementation: Snapshot/delta reconciliation, commit receipts, pause/freeze/restore reset and world-wall texture update.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Two clients converge; rejected local preview rolls back; restore discards obsolete deltas.

tasks.title: Personal profile and preferences
tasks.implementation: New ME hub, profile form and low-power/motion/sound/theme preferences; links to party and gift activity.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Optional profile fields do not block world entry; private settings remain identity-scoped.

tasks.title: Notification inbox
tasks.implementation: New unread count/list, mark-read/all-read and safe deep-link routing with stale-target handling.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Duplicate notification event does not duplicate UI; inaccessible target never exposes cached details.

tasks.title: Report, block, and deletion controls
tasks.implementation: New report dialog, block list/unblock, logout/delete confirmation and progress views; clear private state.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Blocking closes affected panels; unblock does not restore old consent; failed deletion is not displayed as complete.

tasks.title: Moderator review screens
tasks.implementation: New plain tables/forms for report evidence, suspension, hide/restore and action reasons; server-role-aware entry.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Nonmoderator direct route blocked; failed action remains pending/failed rather than successful.

tasks.title: Event operations screens
tasks.implementation: New settings, place review/closure, notice publication, capability flags and audit views.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Confirm risky changes; stale versions conflict; source and review state remain visible.

tasks.title: Wall control and event closure UI
tasks.implementation: New pause/region lock/restore controls and closure step-progress/retry presentation.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Restore confirmation names snapshot; partial closure failure is visible and recoverable.

tasks.title: Read-only archive views
tasks.implementation: New end-of-event page and permitted final mural/feed views; remove all write controls and private activity.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Archive does not contain handles or physical beacons; deleted content stays inaccessible.

tasks.title: Global degraded and lifecycle states
tasks.implementation: New offline/reconnect/maintenance/version/404 states; stale-data labels, foreground resync and render throttling.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: No endless spinner; offline pickup is not queued silently; keyboard and reconnect preserve usable navigation.

tasks.title: Contract and fixture coverage
tasks.implementation: Validate every fixture and generated response shape; run drift and missing-operation probes.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Broken schema and unknown enum cause failure; no empty-test success.

tasks.title: Zero legacy-UI audit
tasks.implementation: Static import/hash check plus manual comparison of all routes against old rendering and approved MCR direction.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: No reused old control/layout/theme; new visual snapshots are reviewed, not blindly accepted.

tasks.title: Database race suite
tasks.implementation: Run parallel capacity, reservation, cancellation, expiry, claim, idempotency and mural-cooldown scenarios against PostgreSQL.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Invariants hold with forced transaction interleavings and worker restarts.

tasks.title: Privacy and authorization matrix
tasks.implementation: Test owner/member/stranger/blocked/suspended/expired/admin across list/detail/mutation/WS/cache.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: No unauthorized handle, claim, evidence, beacon or recipient data in responses or cached UI.

tasks.title: Realtime failure suite
tasks.implementation: Packet delay/gap, slow client, background/foreground, ticket replay, server restart and room switch.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Bounded queues, no ghost player or duplicated room membership, eventual state convergence.

tasks.title: Mobile visual acceptance
tasks.implementation: Test widths 360/390/430, actual iOS Safari and Android Chrome, keyboard, safe area and all three skins.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Avatars remain legible, controls reachable, no panel clipping or old UI; record device/browser versions.

tasks.title: Accessibility and input suite
tasks.implementation: Keyboard/focus/screen-reader labels, DOM alternatives, reduced motion and pointer cancellation.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Essential social/pickup tasks work without precise canvas interaction; focus returns on sheet close.

tasks.title: Capacity and performance qualification
tasks.implementation: Initial 200 sockets/four rooms scenario, mobile rendering/bundle/memory measurements, slow-network and reconnect storms.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Publish measured ceilings and chosen caps; no claim of 200-user support without results.

tasks.title: Recovery and lifecycle rehearsal
tasks.implementation: Database restart/backup restoration, outbox replay, pending pickup, deletion and partial event closure.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Restored state is consistent; no lost committed pickup; shutdown and cleanup are resumable.

tasks.title: Candidate provenance and release checks
tasks.implementation: Verify same-candidate versions, genuine tests, no production mocks/secrets and task-to-commit traceability.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Missing evidence is NOT_RUN/BLOCKED, not PASS; no stale revision substituted for current candidate.

tasks.title: Two-user world gate
tasks.implementation: Two independent accounts enter the same live backend world, move, customize, change skin, navigate panels and reconnect.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Both observe authorized movement; no duplicate game/socket; actual art passes visual check.

tasks.title: Real meetup and pickup gate
tasks.implementation: Party request/approval, physical beacon/rally, giveaway reservation and confirmed pickup on two clients.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Full journey against real services; virtual walking never changes physical arrival.

tasks.title: Social and privacy gate
tasks.implementation: Intro discovery, feed/comment, consent/reveal/revoke, notifications and block propagation.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Restricted age and revoked/blocked cases fail closed on HTTP, WS and client cache.

tasks.title: Shared mural and moderation gate
tasks.implementation: Multiple clients paint, hit cooldown, experience pause, restore and final freeze.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: All clients converge to authoritative revision; unauthorized moderation fails.

tasks.title: Release decision
tasks.implementation: Review same-candidate evidence, scope cuts, operator settings and known limitations; publish pass/block decision.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: All required gates executed; master contains tested code and evidence; no false implementation claims.

tasks.title: Party-only free-text chat
tasks.implementation: Add authorized history/send/reconnect, spam limits, report support, and member-removal revocation.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Removed or blocked user cannot read/send; persisted ordering survives reconnect.

tasks.title: Mural history and souvenir export
tasks.implementation: Snapshot history/time-lapse and opt-in avatar keepsake; rights and consent-aware export.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Private handles/locations excluded; opted-out/deleted avatars handled correctly.

tasks.title: PWA and offline read mode
tasks.implementation: Cache public static assets and permitted read-only material; never cache private reveal responses.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Offline mode labels staleness and cannot silently queue stock or consent mutations.

tasks.title: Additional identity providers
tasks.implementation: Add only configured/verified providers and explicit account-linking conflict handling.
tasks.acceptance_evidence_required: Real provider acceptance and takeover-prevention tests; unavailable provider not advertised as working.
